WhatsApp to allow chats without sharing mobile numbers

WhatsApp is reportedly developing a feature that will allow users to chat with others without sharing their mobile numbers. This change aims to enhance user privacy by enabling communication through alternative identifiers. The development was highlighted by CEO Kunal Shah.
